title: Predictive learning: NLP
reading: The slide presents predictive (self-supervised) learning in natural language processing, using masked language modeling as exemplified by BERT: words or tokens are hidden in a sentence and the model is trained to predict them. A schematic below illustrates the pipeline with a blanked sentence.

visuals.description: A left-to-right flow: a handwritten-style sentence 'The __ opened their __ and began to__' feeds through an arrow into a rounded box labelled 'model', which outputs 'students .. books .. read'.
visuals.assertion: Given a sentence with masked tokens, the model recovers the missing words.

concepts.name: Masked language modeling (BERT)
concepts.why_it_matters: Core self-supervised pretraining objective for NLP models.
